title: LogReceipt
description: A receipt from Trooth's witness statement log (docs/LOG.md): the entry index, a checkpoint signed by the log key, and an RFC 9162 inclusion proof from the entry to the checkpoint root. The entry is RFC 8785 JSON of {kind, statement}; its leaf hash is SHA-256(0x00 || entry).

log.description: The log origin, which the checkpoint must also name.

tree_size.description: The size of the signed tree the proof is against. Equals the checkpoint size.

root_hash.description: Standard base64 of the 32-byte root at tree_size. Equals the checkpoint root.

inclusion_proof.description: The RFC 9162 audit path, leaf to root, each a 32-byte hash in standard base64.

checkpoint.description: A C2SP checkpoint (origin, size, base64 root, each on its own line) followed by a blank line and C2SP signed-note signature lines; the log key's line is an em dash, the key name and base64 of the 4-byte key hash and the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.
